'''Pilf Mukmuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] living during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He also had a yellow brother named [[Pikk Mukmuk/Legends|Pikk]].

==Biography==
[[File:HondoOhnakaAndPilfMukmuk-Revival.png|thumb|left|250px|Pilf with his owner, Hondo.]]
Mukmuk was the pet<ref name=":0" /> and beloved mascot of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]].<ref name="tcwce" /> When Hondo's gang picked up supplies on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], Mukmuk was pouncing along the shoulders of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]]. He leapt onto his Master as he was talking to [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Hondo agreed to transport Dooku to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>

Hondo arranged a group of pirates to surround Dooku once they had transported him, and Mukmuk took both Dooku and Anakin Skywalker's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] (which Dooku had previously taken) in his possession while the Count was locked up.<ref name=":0" />

Hondo informed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that they had Dooku, so [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to check he was there. Skywalker tried to re-claim his lightsaber, but the pirates mistook this for a threat. Mukmuk reclaimed the lightsaber.<ref name=":0" />

Mukmuk played an instrumental role in capturing the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. After several failed attempts to drug their drinks and food, Mukmuk attempted to drop a chandelier down on the Jedi. This attempt was thwarted by Skywalker, who [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pushed]] the fixture clear of them. Frustrated, Mukmuk then just deposited the drug into the ventilation system which succeeded in rendering Kenobi and Skywalker unconscious.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Switch">''[[The Clone Wars: Switch]]''</ref>
[[File:Mukmuk_crawl.png|thumb|right|180px|Pilf at a crawl.]]

Mukmuk was present when [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]], and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|tried to rescue]] the Jedi and retrieve Dooku from the pirates.<ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Pilf Mukmuk was a red skinned [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian-monkey lizard]] who had a carefully groomed neck ruff and a twitted crest tended to by Hondo Ohnaka. His long arms were ideal for stealing.<ref name="tcwce" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pilf was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name=":0" /> In ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', Pilf Mukmuk's description is listed under his brother Pikk's entry. This discrepancy has not been solved.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
